about: What Timbre Push accepts and refuses. ONE table, run twice: by verify-cs.mjs against the
compiled actions/timbre-push.cs, and by verify.mjs against the mock's mirror of it
(mock-sb-server.mjs, runTimbrePush). The two must give the same answer for every row.
tools/cs/push-cases.mjs turns a row into the text that is sent.
A row is one of:
text    the config text, as it is
full    a full config, as today's dock sends it: JSON.stringify(sanitizeConfig(defaultConfig())),
changed by: drop (dotted paths taken out), set (top-level keys put in), pretty (indented),
swap ([from, to]: one piece of the text replaced), before / after (text put round it),
padBefore (that many spaces in front), size (padded with a top-level "pad" string to
exactly that many UTF-16 units)
repeat  [text, count]
where: "push" (the default) sends the text as the config argument, with a known config stored;
"cache" stores the text as timbre.config (as an older action, or anything else, left it)
and then asks for a sync.
expect: push: "accept" (stored trimmed, broadcast) or the code it is refused with (nothing stored);
cache: "replay" (broadcast, trimmed) or "bad-cache" (not broadcast, and not deleted).
gap: true marks text that is NOT JSON and passes all the same: what the structure check does not catch.
Besides these rows, both runs add one row for each top-level key of defaultConfig(): a full
config without that key is refused as partial-config.

errors.bad-config: the config is not one JSON object
errors.partial-config: the config is not a full config
errors.bad-cache: the saved config is damaged; change a setting to replace it
